annotations.title: Scan a Page, store or ad on my SpyWinAds app

description: When spywin_get_page_ads, spywin_spy_store_ads or spywin_lookup_video_ad say the library does not have it yet, ask the user's own SpyWinAds desktop app to scan it from the user's home network. kind: page (Facebook Page link or ID), store (domain), ad (Ad Library link or ad ID). Uses the plan's daily competitor-research limit. If the app is closed, not installed, or Facebook is pausing the home network, nothing is queued and the status says so. Returns a request_id for spywin_get_scan_status; when done, call the lookup tool again.

target.description: Facebook Page link / ID, store domain, or Ad Library link / ad ID

name: spywin_queue_page_scan
